correctness.rationale: The normalized two-boson star space decomposes into one trivial four-dimensional block, \(m-1\) standard three-dimensional blocks, and a zero-energy leaf-pair incidence kernel of dimension \(m(m-3)/2\). Independent Jacobi determinants give the two cubic factors. Their exact subtraction is \(m(U-3x)\), while \(Q_{\mathrm{st}}(U/3)=2U[9(m-3)-U^2]/27\); hence the unique positive shared root occurs at \(U=3\sqrt{m-3}\) with total multiplicity \(m\). Root signs and limiting middle-root asymptotics prove strict reversal and exclude other crossings. Independent full Hamiltonian polynomials and exact ranks confirm \(4\le m\le8\) and resonances at \(m=4,7\). Finite checks support but do not replace the all-size proof.

value.rationale: The all-size resonance resolves a nontrivial spectroscopic level-order question at a tunable physical interaction. It separates one symmetry singlet from an \((m-1)\)-fold multiplet, with an experimentally interpretable interaction calibration \(U/J=3\sqrt{m-3}\) across all star valences. The crossing lies between different permutation irreducibles, invisible to a hub-initial fully symmetric experiment, rather than being a routine determinant evaluation or a known zero-interaction dark-state count.
